title: How to change cursor in Canva on Mac: system settings and presenter view adjustments
metaTitle: How to change cursor in Canva on Mac: Quick Guide
description: Learn how to change cursor in Canva on Mac by adjusting system settings or hiding the Magic Cursor during presentations. Follow our step-by-step guide.
intro: Canva does not offer an internal setting to change your cursor icon. You must adjust your macOS system settings to modify your cursor appearance or use the presenter menu to hide the Magic Cursor.
tldr: Use macOS System Settings to change pointer size and color globally.
Disable the Magic Cursor in Presenter View via the three-dot menu.
Canva automatically updates your cursor based on the tool you select.
The Canva Mac app follows your system-level mouse and trackpad preferences.

blocks.text: Understanding cursor behavior in Canva

Canva functions as a web-based platform, even when using the dedicated Mac application. Because of this, the application does not have a unique cursor engine. It relies on your browser or the macOS system to render the pointer. When you move your mouse over different elements, the cursor changes automatically. This is standard behavior for design tools.

If you are struggling to see your cursor or find it too small, the best approach is to modify your Mac settings. These changes apply to every app you open, including Canva. This ensures a consistent experience across your entire workflow. You can change the size, the border color, and the fill color of your pointer.
Changing your cursor size and color via macOS

To make your cursor more visible while working on complex designs, head to your System Settings. This is the most effective way to change how your mouse appears on screen. Follow these steps to adjust your pointer control settings.

items: Click the Apple menu icon () in the top-left corner of your screen.
Select System Settings from the drop-down menu.
Navigate to the Accessibility section in the sidebar.
Click on Pointer Control.
Use the Pointer size slider to increase or decrease the size of your cursor.
Adjust the Pointer outline color and Pointer fill color to your preference.

blocks.text: Once you apply these changes, they take effect immediately. You will notice the difference the next time you click back into your Canva window. If you find the cursor too large or distracting, return to this menu to reset your settings to the default state.
Managing the Magic Cursor in Presenter View

If you are presenting a design, you might notice a blue tracking ball or a 'Magic Cursor' that highlights your movements for the audience. This is a helpful feature for tutorials, but it can be distracting if you want a clean look. You can turn this off easily.

items: Enter Presenter View in your Canva design.
Look for the three-dot (···) menu icon at the top of your screen.
Click the menu to open the presentation settings.
Find the option labeled Hide Magic Cursor.
Select it to disable the tracking effect.

blocks.text: This setting is specific to your presentation session. If you start a new presentation, you may need to check your settings again. Canva remembers your preferences for the duration of the current window.
Common cursor issues in Canva

Users occasionally report that the cursor feels sluggish or does not respond as expected. This is usually due to the complexity of the design or the number of elements on the canvas. Canva handles millions of designs, but extremely large files with thousands of layers can cause lag.
If your cursor disappears or gets stuck, try these quick fixes:

items: Refresh your browser tab or restart the Canva desktop app.
Check your internet connection, as Canva requires a stable link for real-time updates.
Clear your browser cache if you are using the web version.
Ensure your macOS is updated to the latest version to maintain compatibility.

blocks.text: Another common issue is the confusion between the mouse cursor and the 'Cursor' AI code editor. Some users search for 'change cursor' hoping to integrate AI coding tools into Canva. While you can use third-party tools to connect workflows, the Canva interface itself does not allow you to change your cursor to an AI-powered code editor.
Collaborative design and pointer visibility

Canva is a collaborative platform. If you are working on a whiteboard or a shared design, you will see the cursors of other team members. This is useful for real-time feedback. Up to 50 users can be active on a single whiteboard simultaneously.

The system processes these updates at a rate of 3 updates per second per user. This keeps the experience smooth even when many people are working at once. If you find the cursors of your team members distracting, you can often hide them using the collaboration settings in your account.
Keyboard shortcuts to speed up your work

While you cannot change the cursor icon, you can use keyboard shortcuts to change what the cursor does. This is often faster than clicking through menus. Mastering these shortcuts will make your design process much more efficient.

items: Press T to instantly select the text tool.
Press R to create a rectangle.
Press C to create a circle.
Press L to draw a line.
Press Spacebar and drag to pan across your design.

blocks.text: These keys change your cursor into the corresponding tool. For example, pressing T turns your cursor into a text insertion point. This is the closest you can get to 'changing' your cursor in Canva. It is a powerful way to keep your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on the design.
Use the macOS character picker (⌘ + ⌃ + Space) if you need to insert special characters that your standard cursor cannot easily trigger.
blocks.title: Pro Tip

faq.question: Can I change the cursor icon in Canva?
faq.answer: No, Canva does not support changing the cursor icon. You can only change the cursor size and color through your macOS System Settings.

faq.question: Why does my cursor show a blue ball during presentations?
faq.answer: That is the Magic Cursor. You can hide it by clicking the three-dot menu in the Presenter View and selecting Hide Magic Cursor.

faq.question: How do I make my cursor larger on Mac?
faq.answer: Go to Apple Menu > System Settings > Accessibility > Pointer Control and use the slider to adjust the pointer size.

steps.name: Open System Settings
steps.text: Click the Apple menu () and select System Settings to begin changing your cursor size.

steps.name: Adjust Pointer Size
steps.text: Move the Pointer size slider to your preferred setting to make your cursor easier to see.
steps.tip: Larger cursors are helpful for video tutorials.

steps.name: Disable Magic Cursor
steps.text: If you are presenting, click the three-dot menu in your presentation window to hide the Magic Cursor.

troubleshooting.fix: Restart the Canva app or refresh your browser tab to clear temporary data.

troubleshooting.problem: Cannot find the Magic Cursor setting
troubleshooting.fix: Ensure you are in Presenter View, as this option is not available in the standard editor.

lazur.spoken: Where can I find the presentation settings to turn off the Magic Cursor?
lazur.result: Lazur will highlight the three-dot menu on your screen where the presentation controls are located.
